statutory.disclaimer.english: Vyaamikk Diary provides general statutory date information for convenience. Applicability depends on your registration, turnover, filing frequency and facts. Due dates may change by government notification. Please verify on the official portal or with your CA/CS/tax professional.

statutory.empty.message.english: When a standard due date is within the reminder window, it will appear here.

statutory.prompt.subtitle.english: A few standard due dates may be relevant soon.

statutory.prompt.footer.english: Information only. Due dates may change by notification.

statutory.caution.standard.english: Standard deadline shown. Government may extend or alter due dates by notification. Verify on GST portal or with your professional.

statutory.caution.income_tax.english: Standard Income Tax timeline shown. Due dates may be extended. Verify on the Income Tax portal or with your professional.

statutory.caution.mca.english: Standard MCA timeline shown. Fees and dates may change. Verify on MCA portal or with your professional.

statutory.notes.gst_interest.english: If applicable, delayed GST tax payment may attract interest (Section 50 CGST — commonly 18% p.a. subject to notification).

statutory.notes.gst_late_fee.english: If applicable, delayed GST returns may attract late fee (often cited ₹50/day, ₹20/day nil returns — subject to caps/waivers).

statutory.notes.it_234bc.english: If applicable, default/deferment of advance tax may attract interest under sections 234B/234C.

statutory.notes.it_234f.english: If applicable, belated ITR may attract fee under section 234F (e.g. ₹5,000 / ₹1,000 by income slab).

statutory.notes.tds_234e.english: If applicable, late TDS return may attract fee under section 234E (₹200/day, capped).

statutory.notes.tds_interest.english: If applicable, TDS default may attract interest — consult your professional; app does not compute.

statutory.notes.llp_late_fee.english: If applicable, delayed LLP Form 8/11 may attract MCA additional fees — verify current MCA fee slab.

statutory.templates.gst_gstr1_monthly.ap.english: If you file monthly GSTR-1 for outward supplies.

statutory.templates.gst_gstr1_monthly.bo.english: Standard due date is generally the 11th of the succeeding month.

statutory.templates.gst_gstr1_quarterly..english: If you file quarterly GSTR-1 under QRMP.
Standard due date is generally the 13th of the month after the quarter.

statutory.templates.gst_gstr3b_monthly.a.english: If you file monthly GSTR-3B summary return and pay GST.

statutory.templates.gst_gstr3b_monthly.b.english: Standard due date is generally the 20th of the succeeding month.

statutory.templates.gst_gstr3b_qrmp.appl.english: If you file quarterly GSTR-3B under QRMP (State/UT may affect day).

statutory.templates.gst_gstr3b_qrmp.body.english: Standard due date is generally the 22nd or 24th after the quarter — verify for your State/UT.

statutory.templates.gst_qrmp_pmt06.appli.english: If you are on QRMP and must pay tax monthly for the first two months of the quarter.

statutory.templates.gst_qrmp_pmt06.body.english: PMT-06 challan is generally due by the 25th of the next month.

statutory.templates.gst_cmp08.applicabil.english: If you are a composition taxpayer.

statutory.templates.gst_cmp08.body.english: CMP-08 statement/payment is generally due by the 18th after the quarter.

statutory.templates.gst_gstr4_annual.app.english: If you must file annual GSTR-4 as a composition taxpayer.

statutory.templates.gst_gstr4_annual.bod.english: Generally due by 30 April after the financial year (extensions possible).

statutory.templates.gst_gstr9_annual.app.english: If you must file GST annual return (turnover/category dependent).

statutory.templates.gst_gstr9_annual.bod.english: Generally due by 31 December following the financial year unless exempted/extended.

statutory.templates.gst_gstr9c_annual.ap.english: If turnover threshold requires reconciliation statement / self-certification.

statutory.templates.gst_gstr9c_annual.bo.english: Generally due by 31 December following the financial year unless extended.

statutory.templates.gst_note_interest.ap.english: If GST tax was paid after the due date.

statutory.templates.gst_note_interest.bo.english: Interest may apply on delayed tax (Section 50 — rate per notification, commonly up to 18% p.a.).

statutory.templates.gst_note_late_fee.ti.english: GST late fee on delayed returns

statutory.templates.gst_note_late_fee.ap.english: If a GST return was filed late.

statutory.templates.gst_note_late_fee.bo.english: Late fee may apply (Section 47 framework; amounts vary by form/notification).

statutory.templates.it_advance_general.a.english: If your estimated annual tax liability exceeds ₹10,000.

statutory.templates.it_advance_jun.body.english: If required, cumulative 15% of estimated liability is generally due by 15 June.

statutory.templates.it_advance_sep.body.english: If required, cumulative 45% is generally due by 15 September.

statutory.templates.it_advance_dec.body.english: If required, cumulative 75% is generally due by 15 December.

statutory.templates.it_advance_mar.body.english: If required, 100% cumulative is generally due by 15 March.

statutory.templates.it_presumptive_mar.a.english: If you are on presumptive taxation under 44AD/44ADA.

statutory.templates.it_presumptive_mar.b.english: Generally 100% advance tax by 15 March (payments up to 31 March may still count as advance tax).

statutory.templates.it_itr_salaried.appl.english: If you must file ITR as a salaried or ordinary non-audit individual.

statutory.templates.it_itr_salaried.body.english: Usual due date is 31 July of the assessment year unless extended (e.g. 31 August for some AY categories).

statutory.templates.it_itr_business_non_.english: If you must file business/profession ITR without tax audit.
For many cases 31 August applies for AY 2026-27 — confirm your category on the portal.

statutory.templates.it_itr_audit.applica.english: If your accounts are subject to tax audit.

statutory.templates.it_itr_audit.body.english: Common due date is 31 October of the assessment year unless extended.

statutory.templates.it_tax_audit_report..english: If tax audit applies and ITR due date is 31 October.
Audit report is generally due by 30 September (one month before ITR due date).

statutory.templates.it_itr_transfer_pric.english: Common ITR due date is 30 November; confirm report timelines with your professional.

statutory.templates.it_tp_report_92e.bod.english: Report is generally due about one month before the applicable ITR due date (e.g. 31 October).

statutory.templates.tds_monthly_deposit..english: If you deduct TDS as a non-government deductor.
Generally due by the 7th of the next month; March deductions by 30 April.

statutory.templates.tds_return.applicabi.english: If you file quarterly TDS returns (24Q/26Q/27Q etc.).

statutory.templates.tds_certificate_note.english: If you issue TDS certificates to deductees.
Form 16A generally quarterly after return processing; Form 16 annually for salary.

statutory.templates.llp_form11.applicabi.english: If you have an LLP (even with no activity).

statutory.templates.llp_form11.body.english: Due by 30 May each year (within 60 days of financial year end).

statutory.templates.llp_audit_threshold..english: If LLP turnover/contribution crosses applicable limits.
Audit may apply (commonly cited above ₹40 lakh turnover or ₹25 lakh contribution — verify current law).

statutory.templates.llp_itr.applicabilit.english: If your LLP must file Income Tax return (ITR-5).

statutory.templates.llp_itr_non_audit.bo.english: Due date follows non-audit business timeline (often 31 August) — confirm audit applicability.

statutory.templates.llp_itr_audit.body.english: Often 31 October for audit cases; 30 November for transfer pricing — confirm facts.

datePolicy.errors.freight_event.too_old.english: Freight date can be within 15 days before or after today.

statutory.disclaimer.english: Vyaamikk Diary provides general statutory date information for convenience. Applicability depends on your registration, turnover, filing frequency and facts. Due dates may change by government notification. Please verify on the official portal or with your CA/CS/tax professional.

statutory.empty.message.english: When a standard due date is within the reminder window, it will appear here.

statutory.prompt.subtitle.english: A few standard due dates may be relevant soon.

statutory.prompt.footer.english: Information only. Due dates may change by notification.

statutory.caution.standard.english: Standard deadline shown. Government may extend or alter due dates by notification. Verify on GST portal or with your professional.

statutory.caution.income_tax.english: Standard Income Tax timeline shown. Due dates may be extended. Verify on the Income Tax portal or with your professional.

statutory.caution.mca.english: Standard MCA timeline shown. Fees and dates may change. Verify on MCA portal or with your professional.

statutory.notes.gst_interest.english: If applicable, delayed GST tax payment may attract interest (Section 50 CGST — commonly 18% p.a. subject to notification).

statutory.notes.gst_late_fee.english: If applicable, delayed GST returns may attract late fee (often cited ₹50/day, ₹20/day nil returns — subject to caps/waivers).

statutory.notes.it_234bc.english: If applicable, default/deferment of advance tax may attract interest under sections 234B/234C.

statutory.notes.it_234f.english: If applicable, belated ITR may attract fee under section 234F (e.g. ₹5,000 / ₹1,000 by income slab).

statutory.notes.tds_234e.english: If applicable, late TDS return may attract fee under section 234E (₹200/day, capped).

statutory.notes.tds_interest.english: If applicable, TDS default may attract interest — consult your professional; app does not compute.

statutory.notes.llp_late_fee.english: If applicable, delayed LLP Form 8/11 may attract MCA additional fees — verify current MCA fee slab.

statutory.templates.gst_gstr1_monthly.ap.english: If you file monthly GSTR-1 for outward supplies.

statutory.templates.gst_gstr1_monthly.bo.english: Standard due date is generally the 11th of the succeeding month.

statutory.templates.gst_gstr1_quarterly..english: If you file quarterly GSTR-1 under QRMP.
Standard due date is generally the 13th of the month after the quarter.

statutory.templates.gst_gstr3b_monthly.a.english: If you file monthly GSTR-3B summary return and pay GST.

statutory.templates.gst_gstr3b_monthly.b.english: Standard due date is generally the 20th of the succeeding month.

statutory.templates.gst_gstr3b_qrmp.appl.english: If you file quarterly GSTR-3B under QRMP (State/UT may affect day).

statutory.templates.gst_gstr3b_qrmp.body.english: Standard due date is generally the 22nd or 24th after the quarter — verify for your State/UT.

statutory.templates.gst_qrmp_pmt06.appli.english: If you are on QRMP and must pay tax monthly for the first two months of the quarter.

statutory.templates.gst_qrmp_pmt06.body.english: PMT-06 challan is generally due by the 25th of the next month.

statutory.templates.gst_cmp08.applicabil.english: If you are a composition taxpayer.

statutory.templates.gst_cmp08.body.english: CMP-08 statement/payment is generally due by the 18th after the quarter.

statutory.templates.gst_gstr4_annual.app.english: If you must file annual GSTR-4 as a composition taxpayer.

statutory.templates.gst_gstr4_annual.bod.english: Generally due by 30 April after the financial year (extensions possible).

statutory.templates.gst_gstr9_annual.app.english: If you must file GST annual return (turnover/category dependent).

statutory.templates.gst_gstr9_annual.bod.english: Generally due by 31 December following the financial year unless exempted/extended.

statutory.templates.gst_gstr9c_annual.ap.english: If turnover threshold requires reconciliation statement / self-certification.

statutory.templates.gst_gstr9c_annual.bo.english: Generally due by 31 December following the financial year unless extended.

statutory.templates.gst_note_interest.ap.english: If GST tax was paid after the due date.

statutory.templates.gst_note_interest.bo.english: Interest may apply on delayed tax (Section 50 — rate per notification, commonly up to 18% p.a.).

statutory.templates.gst_note_late_fee.ti.english: GST late fee on delayed returns

statutory.templates.gst_note_late_fee.ap.english: If a GST return was filed late.

statutory.templates.gst_note_late_fee.bo.english: Late fee may apply (Section 47 framework; amounts vary by form/notification).

statutory.templates.it_advance_general.a.english: If your estimated annual tax liability exceeds ₹10,000.

statutory.templates.it_advance_jun.body.english: If required, cumulative 15% of estimated liability is generally due by 15 June.

statutory.templates.it_advance_sep.body.english: If required, cumulative 45% is generally due by 15 September.

statutory.templates.it_advance_dec.body.english: If required, cumulative 75% is generally due by 15 December.

statutory.templates.it_advance_mar.body.english: If required, 100% cumulative is generally due by 15 March.

statutory.templates.it_presumptive_mar.a.english: If you are on presumptive taxation under 44AD/44ADA.

statutory.templates.it_presumptive_mar.b.english: Generally 100% advance tax by 15 March (payments up to 31 March may still count as advance tax).

statutory.templates.it_itr_salaried.appl.english: If you must file ITR as a salaried or ordinary non-audit individual.

statutory.templates.it_itr_salaried.body.english: Usual due date is 31 July of the assessment year unless extended (e.g. 31 August for some AY categories).

statutory.templates.it_itr_business_non_.english: If you must file business/profession ITR without tax audit.
For many cases 31 August applies for AY 2026-27 — confirm your category on the portal.

statutory.templates.it_itr_audit.applica.english: If your accounts are subject to tax audit.

statutory.templates.it_itr_audit.body.english: Common due date is 31 October of the assessment year unless extended.

statutory.templates.it_tax_audit_report..english: If tax audit applies and ITR due date is 31 October.
Audit report is generally due by 30 September (one month before ITR due date).

statutory.templates.it_itr_transfer_pric.english: Common ITR due date is 30 November; confirm report timelines with your professional.

statutory.templates.it_tp_report_92e.bod.english: Report is generally due about one month before the applicable ITR due date (e.g. 31 October).

statutory.templates.tds_monthly_deposit..english: If you deduct TDS as a non-government deductor.
Generally due by the 7th of the next month; March deductions by 30 April.

statutory.templates.tds_return.applicabi.english: If you file quarterly TDS returns (24Q/26Q/27Q etc.).

statutory.templates.tds_certificate_note.english: If you issue TDS certificates to deductees.
Form 16A generally quarterly after return processing; Form 16 annually for salary.

statutory.templates.llp_form11.applicabi.english: If you have an LLP (even with no activity).

statutory.templates.llp_form11.body.english: Due by 30 May each year (within 60 days of financial year end).

statutory.templates.llp_audit_threshold..english: If LLP turnover/contribution crosses applicable limits.
Audit may apply (commonly cited above ₹40 lakh turnover or ₹25 lakh contribution — verify current law).

statutory.templates.llp_itr.applicabilit.english: If your LLP must file Income Tax return (ITR-5).

statutory.templates.llp_itr_non_audit.bo.english: Due date follows non-audit business timeline (often 31 August) — confirm audit applicability.

statutory.templates.llp_itr_audit.body.english: Often 31 October for audit cases; 30 November for transfer pricing — confirm facts.

statutory.templates.gst_gstr3b_monthly.a.english: If you file monthly GSTR-3B summary return and pay GST.

statutory.templates.gst_gstr3b_monthly.b.english: Standard due date is generally the 20th of the succeeding month.

statutory.templates.gst_gstr3b_qrmp.appl.english: If you file quarterly GSTR-3B under QRMP (State/UT may affect day).

statutory.templates.gst_gstr3b_qrmp.body.english: Standard due date is generally the 22nd or 24th after the quarter — verify for your State/UT.

statutory.templates.gst_qrmp_pmt06.appli.english: If you are on QRMP and must pay tax monthly for the first two months of the quarter.

statutory.templates.gst_qrmp_pmt06.body.english: PMT-06 challan is generally due by the 25th of the next month.

statutory.templates.gst_cmp08.applicabil.english: If you are a composition taxpayer.

statutory.templates.gst_cmp08.body.english: CMP-08 statement/payment is generally due by the 18th after the quarter.

statutory.templates.gst_gstr4_annual.app.english: If you must file annual GSTR-4 as a composition taxpayer.

statutory.templates.gst_gstr4_annual.bod.english: Generally due by 30 April after the financial year (extensions possible).

statutory.templates.gst_gstr9_annual.app.english: If you must file GST annual return (turnover/category dependent).

statutory.templates.gst_gstr9_annual.bod.english: Generally due by 31 December following the financial year unless exempted/extended.

statutory.templates.gst_gstr9c_annual.ap.english: If turnover threshold requires reconciliation statement / self-certification.

statutory.templates.gst_gstr9c_annual.bo.english: Generally due by 31 December following the financial year unless extended.

statutory.templates.gst_note_interest.ap.english: If GST tax was paid after the due date.

statutory.templates.gst_note_interest.bo.english: Interest may apply on delayed tax (Section 50 — rate per notification, commonly up to 18% p.a.).

statutory.templates.gst_note_late_fee.ti.english: GST late fee on delayed returns

statutory.templates.gst_note_late_fee.ap.english: If a GST return was filed late.

statutory.templates.gst_note_late_fee.bo.english: Late fee may apply (Section 47 framework; amounts vary by form/notification).

statutory.templates.it_advance_general.a.english: If your estimated annual tax liability exceeds ₹10,000.

statutory.templates.it_advance_jun.body.english: If required, cumulative 15% of estimated liability is generally due by 15 June.

statutory.templates.it_advance_sep.body.english: If required, cumulative 45% is generally due by 15 September.

statutory.templates.it_advance_dec.body.english: If required, cumulative 75% is generally due by 15 December.

statutory.templates.it_advance_mar.body.english: If required, 100% cumulative is generally due by 15 March.

statutory.templates.it_presumptive_mar.a.english: If you are on presumptive taxation under 44AD/44ADA.

statutory.templates.it_presumptive_mar.b.english: Generally 100% advance tax by 15 March (payments up to 31 March may still count as advance tax).

statutory.templates.it_itr_salaried.appl.english: If you must file ITR as a salaried or ordinary non-audit individual.

statutory.templates.it_itr_salaried.body.english: Usual due date is 31 July of the assessment year unless extended (e.g. 31 August for some AY categories).

statutory.templates.it_itr_business_non_.english: If you must file business/profession ITR without tax audit.
For many cases 31 August applies for AY 2026-27 — confirm your category on the portal.

statutory.templates.it_itr_audit.applica.english: If your accounts are subject to tax audit.

statutory.templates.it_itr_audit.body.english: Common due date is 31 October of the assessment year unless extended.

statutory.templates.it_tax_audit_report..english: If tax audit applies and ITR due date is 31 October.
Audit report is generally due by 30 September (one month before ITR due date).

statutory.templates.it_itr_transfer_pric.english: Common ITR due date is 30 November; confirm report timelines with your professional.

statutory.templates.it_tp_report_92e.bod.english: Report is generally due about one month before the applicable ITR due date (e.g. 31 October).

statutory.templates.tds_monthly_deposit..english: If you deduct TDS as a non-government deductor.
Generally due by the 7th of the next month; March deductions by 30 April.

statutory.templates.tds_return.applicabi.english: If you file quarterly TDS returns (24Q/26Q/27Q etc.).

statutory.templates.tds_certificate_note.english: If you issue TDS certificates to deductees.
Form 16A generally quarterly after return processing; Form 16 annually for salary.

statutory.templates.llp_form11.applicabi.english: If you have an LLP (even with no activity).

statutory.templates.llp_form11.body.english: Due by 30 May each year (within 60 days of financial year end).

statutory.templates.llp_audit_threshold..english: If LLP turnover/contribution crosses applicable limits.
Audit may apply (commonly cited above ₹40 lakh turnover or ₹25 lakh contribution — verify current law).

statutory.templates.llp_itr.applicabilit.english: If your LLP must file Income Tax return (ITR-5).

statutory.templates.llp_itr_non_audit.bo.english: Due date follows non-audit business timeline (often 31 August) — confirm audit applicability.

statutory.templates.llp_itr_audit.body.english: Often 31 October for audit cases; 30 November for transfer pricing — confirm facts.

datePolicy.hints.materialEvent.english: Dispatch/receipt date can be within the last 15 days through today only.

datePolicy.hints.paymentRequestToday.english: Request date is today only and cannot be backdated. Invoice/due dates may be in the past.

datePolicy.hints.freightWindow.english: Freight date can be within 15 days before or after today.

datePolicy.errors.freight_event.required.english: Freight date is required when set.

datePolicy.errors.freight_event.future.english: Freight date can be within 15 days before or after today.

datePolicy.errors.freight_event.too_old.english: Freight date can be within 15 days before or after today.

cashPaid.receiverMobile.helper.english: Required for Full Legal Record PDF. India numbers only (+91).

cashPaid.receiverMobile.errorInvalid.english: Enter a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number.

cashPaid.denomination.helper.english: Enter note counts if you want them on the PDF. Totals may differ from amount — save is allowed.

cashPaid.denomination.mismatchWarning.english: Note breakdown total does not match the amount. You can still save; Full Legal PDF may require a match.
